## Requirements

1. **Recording-act closures** — licensing (MIT OR Apache-2.0), naming
   (crate scheme `hharness` + `hharness-<component>`, binaries
   `hh`/`hh-kernel`/`hh-helper`, project stays HarnessHarness with the
   `harnessharness` collision recorded), distribution (GitHub Release +
   crates.io, libraries + installable bins), provenance (keep, scrub
   living docs), BL-41/42/43 → maintainer policy — recorded on
   R-2.12.4's register cells and each OQ a ruling fully determines;
   every closure cites the GATE DECISIONS row verbatim.
2. **Naming market check** — crates.io `GET /api/v1/crates/<name>` for
   every to-be-published name enumerated explicitly (umbrella `hharness`
   + one `hharness-<x>` per `cargo metadata` package = 54 names at run
   time), dated per-name result; plus binary names and the recorded
   collisions; GitHub + web collision re-check for "HarnessHarness"
   (OQ-035's WS-L6 re-check leg; ADR-0011 consequence row). Read-only
   public queries; unreachable → honest recorded result. Any taken
   publish-set name = STOP-and-ask — never silently renamed.
3. **Brief file** `docs/build/planning/round4-bl33-ws-l6-briefs.md` —
   batch-adoptable table `| id | proposed disposition | one-line basis |
   conform row |` covering R-2.12.4 + all 13 OQs exactly once;
   `Operator act: "adopt all except: <ids>"`; the four disposition
   tokens only (no keep-open/keep-interim/defer); every
   `needs-code-leg` names its conform row + exact change; trust-field
   section naming proposed trust roots / admission classes for
   `manifest.locations[]` remote fetch (R4.15d contract input).
4. **Engineering cells** — one dated append-only note per id in its
   register row (13 OQ rows; R-2.12.4 coverage + scope-log; R-2.12.5
   coverage; BL-33 landing; DF-S4.2-1 progress).
5. **Flips only where fully met** — BL-33/R-2.12.4/R-2.12.5 cells stay
   as found where any leg remains owed (GATE-G7 adoption, L4.x launch
   implementation); the recording acts + proposals are dated appends.
